protocol.summary: White wire outputs high on motion detection, with a fixed 2-second retriggerable hold described by the product. UIFlow reads the white GPIO and registers rising/falling interrupts.
gaps: A raw GPIO override is not a validated model of AS312 hold/retrigger timing.
